title: Targeting the lactate-lactylation-glucose uptake axis: Cryptotanshinone reprograms metabolic-epigenetic crosstalk in gastric cancer.
authors: Ni, Xiaochen; Wang, Chuhang; Zhang, Kaiyuan; Zhang, Mingsi; Guo, Jianing; Fan, Wei; Zheng, Linfeng; Jiang, Tao; Zhang, Guangji
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究隐丹参酮通过抑制ENO1降低乳酸和组蛋白乳酰化修饰来重编程胃癌代谢-表观遗传串扰，虽涉及蛋白-小分子互作和表观遗传调控，但核心并非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，且方法以实验为主，仅分子对接辅助，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Gastric cancer remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, with chemotherapy resistance and severe side effects posing significant challenges. Metabolic reprogramming, particularly lactate-driven histone lactylation, plays a crucial role in tumor progression. Cryptotanshinone (CTS), a bioactive compound from Salvia miltiorrhiza, has demonstrated anti-tumor properties, yet its mechanisms in regulating lactate metabolism and lactylation in gastric cancer remain unclear. PURPOSE: This study aimed to elucidate the molecular mechanisms by which CTS inhibits gastric cancer progression, focusing on its effects on enolase activity, lactate production, histone lactylation, and downstream metabolic-epigenetic regulation. METHODS: We screened Salvia miltiorrhiza ethanol extract (SME) and identified CTS as a key component targeting enolase. Molecular docking, surface plasmon resonance, and limited proteolysis-mass spectrometry were used to confirm CTS-ENO1 interaction. In vitro and in vivo models, including cell lines, xenografts, and patient-derived organoids, were employed to assess anti-tumor effects. Glycolytic function, histone lactylation, and gene expression were evaluated via seahorse assay, western blot, Cut&Tag, and RNA-seq. RESULTS: CTS directly binds to and inhibits enolase ENO1, reducing phosphoenolpyruvate (PEP) and lactate production. Decreased lactate levels led to reduced global histone lactylation, particularly at H3K18. CTS also enhanced HDAC2-mediated de-lactylation by lowering PEP, which otherwise inhibits HDAC2. Downregulation of H3K18la suppressed MGAT4A expression, impairing GLUT1 membrane localization and glucose uptake, thereby forming a feedback loop that inhibits glycolysis. CTS significantly suppressed tumor growth in xenograft and patient-derived organoid models, effects reversible by exogenous lactate.
abstract_zh: 背景：胃癌仍是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一，化疗耐药和严重副作用构成重大挑战。代谢重编程，特别是乳酸驱动的组蛋白乳酸化 (histone lactylation)，在肿瘤进展中发挥关键作用。隐丹参酮 (Cryptotanshinone, CTS)，一种来自丹参 (Salvia miltiorrhiza) 的生物活性化合物，已显示出抗肿瘤特性，但其在胃癌中调节乳酸代谢和乳酸化的机制仍不清楚。目的：本研究旨在阐明CTS抑制胃癌进展的分子机制，重点关注其对烯醇化酶活性、乳酸产生、组蛋白乳酸化及下游代谢-表观遗传调控的影响。方法：我们筛选了丹参乙醇提取物 (SME)，并鉴定CTS为靶向烯醇化酶的关键组分。采用分子对接 (molecular docking)、表面等离子体共振 (surface plasmon resonance) 和有限蛋白水解-质谱法 (limited proteolysis-mass spectrometry) 确认CTS-ENO1相互作用。利用体外和体内模型，包括细胞系、异种移植瘤和患者来源类器官，评估抗肿瘤效果。通过海马测定 (seahorse assay)、蛋白质印迹 (western blot)、Cut&Tag和RNA-seq评估糖酵解功能、组蛋白乳酸化和基因表达。结果：CTS直接结合并抑制烯醇化酶ENO1，减少磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸 (PEP) 和乳酸产生。乳酸水平降低导致整体组蛋白乳酸化减少，特别是在H3K18位点。CTS还通过降低PEP增强HDAC2介导的去乳酸化，而PEP否则会抑制HDAC2。H3K18la下调抑制MGAT4A表达，损害GLUT1膜定位和葡萄糖摄取，从而形成抑制糖酵解的反馈回路。CTS在异种移植瘤和患者来源类器官模型中显著抑制肿瘤生长，这些效应可被外源性乳酸逆转。
